role: Mutation-driven characterisation tests for the recovery/readiness scoring maths: RHR adjustment direction and clamp, DFA alpha1 bands, baseline staleness, zero-RMSSD fallbacks, sleep stage scoring, SpO2 penalty and composite clamp, perceived-readiness blend, missing-sleep penalty, freshness bonus cap, ACWR ramp/rescue, readiness clamp and labels, RHR vitals sub-score, scoring-parameter invariants and RMSSD finiteness.
types: ScoringCharacterizationTests: class — XCTestCase pinning surviving mutations in RecoveryScoreCalculator and friends
toplevel: File header documents a mutation-testing run (30 mutations, 15 survivors) motivating one test per survivor.

flags.text: The fixture night is physically impossible (deep 440 + REM 110 = 550 stage minutes in a 450-minute night, awake 0), and the M12 mutation it is named for (removing the min(...,1.0) stage-ratio cap in basicSleepScore) is in code this test never reaches; the test exercises SleepScienceAnalyzer's enhanced score instead, so the listed surviving mutation still survives.

flags.text: The three constant assertions (basic sleep weights sum to 1, deep != REM weight, deep != REM target) pin values that production documents as unable to affect any score: basicSleepScore is reached only when SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze returns nil (nightSleepMinutes <= 0), where stageRatio returns its neutral 0.5 before weights or targets matter. Swapping the weights (M13) still changes no app score; the test only pins inert constants.
